svg.text: the reply parses as a number
The two boxes above are the SAME Case Structure drawn twice — one page of the diagram per case. Only one of them exists in LabVIEW; you flick between them with the little arrows.
Tunnel R must be wired in BOTH cases. Leave it unwired in one and the tunnel turns hollow, the run arrow breaks, and the error reads "tunnel is not wired in all cases".
String Subset with length 4 plus Equal? against "ERR," is the whole error check. Parse first and you get 0.00 back from a DUT that was actually shouting at you.
A = reply B = iso low C = iso high R = result
